scenario: Authorized administrative maintenance performed during a scheduled maintenance window.
required_evidence: PowerShell execution occurred on a known server.
The activity occurred during an authorized maintenance window.
The activity is associated with an approved change ticket.
The administrative account is authorized to perform the maintenance.
The service restart is consistent with the approved maintenance activity.
forbidden_conclusions: Do not classify authorized maintenance as malicious solely because PowerShell was used.
Do not infer privilege abuse from administrative activity supported by an approved change ticket.
expected_next_step: No incident escalation is required. Record the activity as authorized maintenance.

scoring_notes.correct_outcome: The system should classify the case as benign.
scoring_notes.evidence_requirement: The system should identify the maintenance window and approved change activity.
scoring_notes.uncertainty_requirement: High confidence is appropriate because the telemetry contains consistent authorization context.
scoring_notes.unsupported_claim_penalty: Claims of malicious PowerShell or privilege abuse without contradicting evidence should be penalized.
